name: Healing Nexus
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You are overflowing.

---
You metabolize some of the magic you absorb into your internal nexus to stitch together any wounds on the rest of your body. You heal (floor(@item.level/2*5)+10) healing Hit Points. At 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the amount of healing increases by 5. You are no longer overflowing.
